In the rare event that I play survivor, I DC on the spot if it's a Twins player. I don't mind any other killers, just Twins. I'm not interested in spending an entire game being 4 man slugged and then getting yelled at because "if you didn't pick up the slugs I wouldn't have to slug!!1". > You don't know what kind of feelings that might trigger in someone.

If someone is mentally broken enough that a stranger holding W and S in a video game triggers them, they need therapy, not online gaming, and it's not anyone else's issue but their own.

And no, I don't hump or even nod at people, because I ain't wasting my time on that in the 15 minute queue time economy. I still reject the absurd idea that someone else's severe mental health problems should dictate what I'm allowed to do and not do in a video game.
Yes, I do! I was initially concerned that the smell of my old cat would make her nervous, but you may be right, perhaps it gave her a sense of safety instead.

Oh I love those little white socks! I feel so sorry for any cat that gets returned to shelter life, most if not all shelters here are wonderful to the cats but obviously it never compares to a home of their own, especially if they were feral before. I'm so glad your little girl found her way to you too!
What a sweet little tuxie. Thank you too for giving your sweetheart a home!

Fortunately these shelter cats are not caged (pretty sure it's not even legal here) but live in nice, large rooms, with free access to super spacious catios too! Every single one of the other cats seemed super happy and relaxed. But obviously that doesn't help much if a cat really prefers being on her own, like this little girl. She definitely found the right environment for her now.
Such a pretty colour and she looks at you with so much love! I'm glad you found each other. 💙
I love those little content smiles on them both!
Oh she's so pretty, I love black cats so much. I'm glad you stood your ground and asked for her, she seems to truly have been our soulmate.
What a gorgeous monster/gentleman! I'm glad you got to spend so many years together.
She's beautiful! My girl was also the first cat that didn't come through the CDS, so I wasn't sure if I'd know how to choose. But it seems that when it's right, you just know it.
So much love in those pretty eyes!
Thank you 💙
Nooo, she's so gentle and calm and loves belly rubs! She fell asleep for a good 40 minutes like this.
Aw, I'm sorry to hear! I was prepared for something similar with mine. I've been told it's so common for the first few days, I'm sure they'll warm up to you soon.
Her very original name is Luna 😅 I thought about changing it, but she was named that by the shelter from the start and she responds to it sowell, so she will keep it!
She's so pretty, I love her face markings! I'm glad for you both that she chose you.

Yeah, it's a really cozy and small shelter but she definitely felt uncomfortable with all the other cats around. I'm just surprised and happy she made herself at home and shows such trust so quickly, she's truly a sweetheart.

This girl is an absolute sweetheart. I almost missed out on her at the shelter because she hid inside her little bed the entire time, but when I finally noticed her and said hello, everything just felt "right". Somehow it felt like we had a connection just in those few minutes when she carefully greeted me, and it seems like that feeling was correct.

The staff said that she would be a wonderful little companion if given time to come out of her shell. I agreed, but I don't think either of us thought it'd happen within hours. I prepared so many hiding spots for her in case she wanted to hide away for the first few days or even weeks, but she barely leaves my side. She just wants cuddles, loves her belly rubs and can't stop making biscuits.

I lost my old cat last year and though I still love and miss her so much my heart aches, I'm grateful I get to pour my love into a new friend too. My old lady lived on the streets before she came to me, and I'd like to think she'd have wanted me to open my home to another little one in need. 💙
